title: Pink Travel Gifts for Her
label: Travel Gifts
intro: Travel gifts are for the friend who is always somewhere else. A pink carry-on, packing cubes, a travel jewelry case, a clear toiletry bag and a journal for the window seat make every trip feel organized, even the red-eye. She will stop living out of a tote bag, and her camera roll will thank you.

images.alt: Shoppable collage on dusty blue of a pink hardside carry-on, packing cubes, a travel jewelry case, a clear toiletry bag, a blush journal, a pink neck pillow and a passport cover.
Woman in a camel coat seen from behind rolling a pink hardside carry-on down a frosty farmhouse path at dawn, candy pink crossbody bag, red barn in the distance.
